messages:
Elaine: Quick account-health check — saw a sharp jump in 5xx for AcmeCorp onboarding last night (~21:40 UTC). Error rate went from ~0.6% -> ~5.8% across their routes :warning:
Ravi: Ugh. Can you paste the query/filters you used so I can correlate with infra metrics?
Elaine: pulled errors by status and endpoint for the last 24h: ```SELECT endpoint, status, count(*) AS cnt FROM requests WHERE customer_id='acmecorp' AND ts > now() - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY endpoint,status ORDER BY cnt DESC;```
Jun: ran a quick scan against logs and traces. There's a cluster of 504/timeouts originating from node-pool A (gpu-rt-1) + elevated KV cache misses on long-seq requests. Also saw request tails at 2–3s which pushed queues.
Carlos: Top failing endpoints (AcmeCorp, last 24h):
 - /v1/generate — 42% of customer 5xx (mostly 504 timeouts, clients sending huge prompt batches)
 - /v1/chat/completions — 28% 5xx (some 500 internal errors in kernel selection)
 - /v1/embeddings — 12% rate-limit responses (429) due to retry storms
 - /health/check — 6% (synthetic monitors noisy, low priority)
Marta: FYI the onboarding SDK was batching 50 requests/client call in their latest integration — that's likely creating long compute windows and eviction of KV entries. We tested reducing to 8 per batch in staging and timeouts dropped 70%.
Elaine: nice find. Customer-side mitigation: recommend smaller batch sizes + exponential backoff on 429s. SR created with account notes.
Ravi: I'm pulling node metrics now. Early look: gpu-rt-1 saw 95% util + kernel OOM churn near 21:30–22:10. Posting pod log snippet: ```[runtime] 21:34:12 kernel: oom-kill process=serve pid=2345 reason=alloc-fail; trace hint: kernel swap```.
Jun: also traced retry pattern from a single IP (3.85.22.11) which retried on 429/504 without backoff — created temporary rate-limit rule (10r/s) for that IP.
deploy-bot: deploy runtime-prod @ 1748123300 — rolling patch applied to node-pool A (minor kernel-fence fix) :white_check_mark:
Carlos: Action items: 1) Eng-runtime (Ravi/Jun) to confirm if kernel patch eliminated OOMs and to monitor KV cache miss rate (next 6h). 2) CS (Elaine/Carlos) to reach out to AcmeCorp with batching guidance + suggest SDK patch. 3) Product to consider per-customer soft-throttle on onboarding flows (Marta to follow up).
Marta: I'll draft SDK guidance and a short config snippet for batch sizing.
Elaine: Thanks everyone. I'll escalate renewal risk if errors persist after outreach — will update this thread tomorrow. :thumbsup:
Ravi: will post metric screenshots and traces in the morning.
Carlos: scheduling 30m call with AcmeCorp for tomorrow 10:30 PT.
Elaine: perfect — closing loop for now.
